issues.display_title: Issue #15: Clone /places/coordinates with API-key auth (key from env)
issues.main_description_html:
Static API Key Coordinates Endpoint

Overview

The API exposes the existing coordinates lookup through this endpoint:

GET /v1/places/coordinates
X-Api-Key: <PLACES_API_KEY>

Authentication uses:

  • A fixed header name: X-Api-Key.
  • One static shared key stored in the server's PLACES_API_KEY environment variable.
  • No JWT, per-client keys, or dynamically generated request keys.

The same key is sent on every request. The server does not generate a new key per request.

Server configuration

Generate the key once on the target server:

openssl rand -hex 32

Add the generated 64-character hexadecimal value to the server's .env file:

PLACES_API_KEY=<64-character-hex-value>

Do not generate a new value on every deployment. All API consumers must use the same configured key.

No Docker Compose or Ansible file changes are required. The deployment continues to use the .env file maintained directly on the server.

After adding or changing the value, rebuild and recreate the service so the new environment is loaded:

docker-compose up -d --build --force-recreate

For local development, add the key to the local ignored .env file and run:

go run .

Request

Required query parameters:

  • lat: latitude from -90 to 90.
  • lng: longitude from -180 to 180.

Optional query parameter:

  • app_name: application name used for daily logging. Default: default.

curl

curl "https://<host>/v1/places/coordinates?lat=-6.175392&lng=106.827153" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: <PLACES_API_KEY>"

PowerShell

$apiHost = "https://<host>"
curl.exe "$apiHost/v1/places/coordinates?lat=-6.175392&lng=106.827153" `
  -H "X-Api-Key: $env:PLACES_API_KEY"

Response

The default response is encrypted:

{
  "data": "<encrypted>",
  "ct": 202609010000
}

To receive the raw place object, add ec: false:

curl "https://<host>/v1/places/coordinates?lat=-6.175392&lng=106.827153" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: <PLACES_API_KEY>" \
  -H "ec: false"

The endpoint uses the same handler and response format as /places/coordinates.

Status codes

Status Condition
200 The coordinates were resolved successfully.
400 lat or lng is missing, invalid, or outside its allowed range.
401 X-Api-Key is missing or incorrect.
404 No place was found, or the Typesense/Google lookup failed.
500 PLACES_API_KEY is not configured, or response encryption failed.

Invalid or missing key:

{"error":"Invalid API key"}

Server key not configured:

{"error":"API key not configured"}

Rotation

Only one shared key is supported. Rotation invalidates the old key for every consumer immediately:

  1. Coordinate the new key with every consumer.
  2. Replace PLACES_API_KEY in the server's .env.
  3. Rebuild and recreate the service.
  4. Stop using the old key.

Security

  • Use HTTPS outside localhost.
  • Use the key only for server-to-server calls or behind a trusted proxy.
  • Do not embed the shared key in browser or mobile application code.
  • Do not hard-code the key, commit .env, log the key, or send it in a query parameter.
  • The current Dockerfile copies the server's .env into the image. Treat the image as secret-bearing and never publish it to a public registry.

Goal

Expose a copy of GET /places/coordinates that is protected by a static API key instead of JWT, so third parties can call it without our JWT infrastructure. Response payload must be byte-for-byte identical to the existing endpoint.

Current state

main.go:

router.GET("/places/coordinates", middleware.AuthMiddleware(), handlers.GetPlaceByCoordinates)

middleware.AuthMiddleware() requires either the X-Search-Token shared secret (MAPS_SECRET) or a Bearer JWT plus an X-Domain header (gothru / panorra).

Reference request:

GET /places/coordinates?lat=-6.175392&lng=106.827153

Scope

  1. New middleware middleware.APIKeyMiddleware() in middleware/auth.go:

    • Reads the key from the X-Api-Key request header.
    • Compares against os.Getenv("PLACES_API_KEY").
    • Compare with crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare (not ==) to avoid timing leaks.
    • If PLACES_API_KEY is unset/empty ??? 500 {"error": "API key not configured"}. It must never fall through to "allow".
    • Missing or wrong key ??? 401 {"error": "Invalid API key"}.
    • Skip the check for OPTIONS (CORS preflight), same as the existing middlewares.

  2. New route in main.go:

router.GET("/v1/places/coordinates", middleware.APIKeyMiddleware(), handlers.GetPlaceByCoordinates)

Reuse handlers.GetPlaceByCoordinates as-is ??? do not copy the handler. Same handler = identical payload for free, and one place to fix bugs.

  1. Env: add PLACES_API_KEY to .env, docker-compose.yml, and the Ansible deploy vars. Generate the value with openssl rand -hex 32. Do not commit a real key.

  2. Docs: add the endpoint + header to test_headers.md.

Payload ??? must match exactly

Same as /places/coordinates today, which means whatever respondWithData produces:

  • Default: {"data": "<encrypted>", "ct": <int>}
  • Encryption-disabled header path: the raw object
  • lat/lng missing or unparseable ??? 400
  • lat outside ??90 / lng outside ??180 ??? 400
  • No result ??? 404 {"error": "place not found"}
  • app_name query param still honoured for daily logging

Acceptance criteria

  • curl -H "X-Api-Key: $PLACES_API_KEY" "$HOST/v1/places/coordinates?lat=-6.175392&lng=106.827153" returns the same body as the JWT-authenticated call to /places/coordinates with the same query.
  • Same request with no X-Api-Key ??? 401.
  • Same request with a wrong X-Api-Key ??? 401.
  • Server with PLACES_API_KEY unset ??? 500, not 200.
  • Existing /places/coordinates behaviour is unchanged.
  • go build ./... && go vet ./... pass.
  • One middleware/auth_test.go covering: valid key, missing key, wrong key, unset env.

Out of scope

  • Multiple / per-client API keys, key rotation, usage quotas, rate limiting. Single key from env is enough until a second consumer exists.
  • Accepting the key as a query param (?api_key=) ??? keys in URLs end up in access logs and referrers. Header only.

Route path /v1/places/coordinates and header name X-Api-Key are the defaults; say so on this issue if you want different ones.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #15: Clone /places/coordinates with API-key auth (key from env)

Suite: middleware/auth_test.go & go test -v ./...
Env: Local source & unit test execution on branch qa-testing
Evidence: Go test runner logs & code inspection

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White �pi_key_middleware_valid Request with valid X-Api-Key matching PLACES_API_KEY -> request allowed TP Pass
2 Black �pi_key_middleware_missing Request without X-Api-Key header -> 401 Unauthorized ({"error":"Invalid API key"}) TN Pass
3 Black �pi_key_middleware_wrong Request with wrong X-Api-Key header -> 401 Unauthorized ({"error":"Invalid API key"}) TN Pass
4 Black �pi_key_middleware_unset_env Server when PLACES_API_KEY is not set -> 500 Internal Server Error ({"error":"API key not configured"}) TN Pass
5 White �pi_key_middleware_options_bypass Preflight OPTIONS request passes without API key check TP Pass
6 White constant_time_comparison API key comparison uses crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare (mitigating timing attacks) TP Pass
7 White
oute_and_handler_reuse Route GET /v1/places/coordinates registers APIKeyMiddleware() and reuses handlers.GetPlaceByCoordinates TP Pass
8 White cors_headers_updated X-Api-Key added to Access-Control-Allow-Headers in CORS middleware TP Pass
9 Task Sprint #15 acceptance All acceptance criteria for issue #15 are met TP + TN Pass

Backend Status Code & Review

Probe Status Response Review
GET /v1/places/coordinates (valid key) 200 / 400 / 404 Expected payload (encrypted / raw) Handler executed with identical payload to existing endpoint
GET /v1/places/coordinates (no key) 401 {"error":"Invalid API key"} Auth rejected as expected
GET /v1/places/coordinates (wrong key) 401 {"error":"Invalid API key"} Auth rejected as expected
GET /v1/places/coordinates (unset env) 500 {"error":"API key not configured"} Server error returned when key is unset
OPTIONS /v1/places/coordinates 204 Headers with X-Api-Key allowed Preflight CORS request allowed

Code Review

  • Middleware (middleware/auth.go): Implements constant-time string comparison (crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare) against PLACES_API_KEY. Proper error handling for missing/wrong key (401) and unset env key (500).
  • Routing (main.go):
    outer.GET("/v1/places/coordinates", middleware.APIKeyMiddleware(), handlers.GetPlaceByCoordinates) reuses existing handler directly without code duplication.
  • CORS (middleware/cors.go): X-Api-Key included in allowed headers.
  • Unit Tests (middleware/auth_test.go): Covers valid key, missing key, wrong key, unset configuration, and OPTIONS preflight bypass (100% pass).
  • Build & Vet: go build ./... and go vet ./... completed with zero errors.

Bug Notes

  • No bugs found. Implementation matches the specification and acceptance criteria.

Result

Passed
